cmd-1791829615298.value:
{"command":"cd ~/cognitum-one/rvcsi.wt-chan && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='crates/rvcsi-cli/src/commands.rs'
s=open(p).read()
a='        let chanspec = 0xc000u16 | 0x2000 | 36; // 5 GHz ch36 80 MHz\n'
b='        // 5 GHz 36/80 as nexmon_csi encodes it (`makecsiparams -c 36/80`): a d11ac\n        // chanspec carries the 80 MHz block\'s centre channel, 42.\n        let chanspec = 0xe02au16;\n'
assert a in s; s=s.replace(a,b)
n=s.count('channels     : [36]')
i=s.index(b)
head,tail=s[:i],s[i:]
# replace only within this test: up to next "#[test]"
j=tail.index('#[test]') if '#[test]' in tail else len(tail)
seg=tail[:j].replace('channels     : [36]','channels     : [42]').replace('VHT80 ch36','VHT80 36/80 (centre 42)')
s=head+seg+tail[j:]
open(p,'w').write(s)
print(n)
EOF
git diff --stat; cargo test -q -p rvcsi-cli -p rvcsi-adapter-nexmon 2>&1 | grep -E "test result|FAILED|panicked" ","exitCode":0,"success":true}
